detail: picked "Must pay, starting from when coverage began"

N.J.A.C. 11:4-41.7(a)2 says the insurer is liable from the policy effective date for a disability from a pre-existing condition that was disclosed in the application and not excluded by rider. Those are exactly the stem's facts, so no second option holds up.
No strong form or common-sense cue. A, B and C are plausible-sounding misconceptions about contestability, pre-existing exclusions and waiting periods.
